pricing_rules_shape_chk.name: pricing_rules_shape_chk
pricing_rules_shape_chk.value:
("pricing_rules"."type" = 'SEASONAL' and "pricing_rules"."valid_during" is not null and "pricing_rules"."adjustment_bp" is not null and not isempty("pricing_rules"."valid_during"))
       or ("pricing_rules"."type" = 'DURATION_DISCOUNT' and "pricing_rules"."min_days" is not null and "pricing_rules"."adjustment_bp" is not null and "pricing_rules"."adjustment_bp" < 0)
       or ("pricing_rules"."type" = 'ONE_WAY_FEE' and "pricing_rules"."fee_fils" is not null)

rental_agreements_return_complete_chk.name: rental_agreements_return_complete_chk
rental_agreements_return_complete_chk.value: ("rental_agreements"."return_at" is null) = ("rental_agreements"."return_mileage_km" is null) and ("rental_agreements"."return_at" is null) = ("rental_agreements"."return_fuel_eighths" is null)

rental_agreements_money_chk.name: rental_agreements_money_chk
rental_agreements_money_chk.value:
"rental_agreements"."late_minutes" >= 0 and "rental_agreements"."late_fee_fils" >= 0 and "rental_agreements"."fuel_charge_fils" >= 0 and "rental_agreements"."damage_charge_fils" >= 0
       and "rental_agreements"."extra_charges_vat_fils" >= 0 and "rental_agreements"."deposit_captured_fils" >= 0 and "rental_agreements"."outstanding_fils" >= 0

reservations_money_chk.name: reservations_money_chk
reservations_money_chk.value:
"reservations"."daily_rate_fils" > 0 and "reservations"."base_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."extras_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."one_way_fee_fils" >= 0
       and "reservations"."discount_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."subtotal_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."vat_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."total_fils" >= 0 and "reservations"."deposit_fils" >= 0

vehicle_occupancy_period_chk.name: vehicle_occupancy_period_chk
vehicle_occupancy_period_chk.value: not isempty("vehicle_occupancy"."period") and lower_inc("vehicle_occupancy"."period") and not upper_inc("vehicle_occupancy"."period")
